title: Mivocabtagene Autoleucel CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Therapy in Stiff Person Syndrome
summary: In this nonrandomized clinical trial, a single dose of mivocabtagene autoleucel resulted in immunotherapy-free remissions with a consistent, well-tolerated safety profile, demonstrating a highly effective therapy in antibody-positive SPS with the potential for durable remissions. Long-term follow-up is ongoing.

summary:

title: Venglustat nears FDA decision in type 3 Gaucher disease
summary:
The FDA is due to decide on Sanofi's venglustat for type 3 Gaucher disease by 25 November, on a 43-patient trial against enzyme replacement therapy.

- The FDA target action date for venglustat in type 3 Gaucher disease is 25 November 2026, under priority review.
- The phase 3 LEAP2MONO trial randomised 43 patients aged 12 and over to venglustat or enzyme replacement therapy.
- Sanofi says the drug met both neurological primary endpoints, but has not published effect sizes in its announcements.

title: 2MM: Pharma Roundup – First DNA therapy approved which could reduce airway surgeries, novel siRNA targets dual lipid pathways, GLP-1s outperform metformin in prediabetes, and Zolgensma tumor risks under FDA review | 2 Minute Medicine
summary: On October 30th, the FDA published a report that Voceryq (doruxapapogene ralaplasmid and lalikinogene sifuplasmid-gxfd) received accelerated approval for the treatment of adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP). This rare, human papillomavirus (HPV) driven disease leads to the formation of growths in patient airways. Approximately 25,000 people in the United States currently have RRP. This groundbreaking therapy marks the first plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy in the United States.
